title: Configure notebook compute
description: Set the notebook's sandbox kernel resources (cpu_cores, memory_gb from supported options; idle_timeout_seconds). Changing cpu_cores or memory_gb restarts a running kernel so the new size takes effect, and the response's restarted says whether that happened. A restart discards every materialized dataframe, so cells that referenced one must run again — prefer sizing the sandbox before the first Python cell runs, and tell the user what a mid-analysis resize will cost them. Changing only idle_timeout_seconds never restarts; restart_required then reports that a live kernel will not pick it up until it restarts on its own. The user pays for the sandbox for as long as it runs, so tell them the response's hourly_price in dollars whenever you set or change the size. That price always describes the sandbox actually serving the notebook, so if a restart failed it is the old one still running, not the size you just set. notebooks-compute-options lists the presets and the values this tool accepts.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: True when a kernel is live and this call did not restart it, so the running sandbox may not match the saved config. A resize restarts the kernel and reports False on success, or True if that restart fails. An idle-timeout change and a no-op on a live kernel also report True.
